name: waitroom
description: Mods that make the wait on a coding agent worth something.

plugins.name: wait-review
plugins.description: Turns the wait while Claude works into incremental review of the diff it already wrote.

plugins.name: bet-on-your-agent
plugins.description: Forecast how a turn will go, and see how your calibration holds up.

plugins.name: wait-ship
plugins.description: Drafts the commit message, PR description and changelog entry for the turn's changes.

plugins.name: wait-breathe
plugins.description: Nudges you to take care of yourself during a long turn.
